verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a first-party auto-shutdown feature that stops a machine after a configurable period of inactivity (one hour to one week), which covers the core of the forgotten-instance protection. However, it is inactivity-triggered rather than a fixed wall-clock timer, and nothing in the pack documents spend limits, budget caps or billing alerts. missing for 10: spend limits/budget caps or billing alerts, fixed-duration shutdown timers independent of activity, API/CLI configuration of auto-shutdown, independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-shutdown works as claimed.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill

citations.quote: The auto-shutdown feature places your machine in a stop state after a predefined period of inactivity, which can range from one hour to one week.
